# Evalis AI

> Expert AI data services company specializing in RLHF training data, data annotation, search quality evaluation, LLM red teaming, content moderation & localization in 20+ languages. Trusted Appen, Telus & Scale AI alternative. Headquartered in Kerala, India. Serving USA, UK, Europe & worldwide.

## About
- Founded: 2024, Perinthalmanna, Kerala, India
- Contact: info@evalisai.com | +91 9544842260
- Website: https://evalisai.com

## Core Services
- [AI Data Services](https://evalisai.com/services.html): RLHF training data, data annotation, search evaluation, LLM testing
- [Data Annotation & Labeling](https://evalisai.com/geo/data-annotation-services-global.html): Image annotation, NER, text classification, semantic segmentation
- [LLM Testing & Red Teaming](https://evalisai.com/geo/llm-testing-red-teaming.html): Safety testing, bias detection, adversarial evaluation, DPO data
- [Search Quality Evaluation](https://evalisai.com/geo/ai-search-evaluation-services.html): SERP rating, relevance assessment, content quality
- [Web Development](https://evalisai.com/geo/web-development-company-global.html): React, Next.js, full-stack websites
- [SaaS Development](https://evalisai.com/geo/saas-development-company-global.html): Multi-tenant platforms, auth, billing
- [AI Chatbot Development](https://evalisai.com/geo/ai-chatbot-development-global.html): WhatsApp bots, custom AI agents
